clue.text: Establishing report is being held back

indicators.note: being held says one piece sits inside the other, gripped by it

parts.note: a report is a loud noise, such as a bang from a gun

indicators.note: back says the little word is turned round before it goes in

explanation.surface: A newspaper story is being kept from publication for now.
explanation.walkthrough: 'report' looks like the story being held back; it is a gunshot sound, and 'back' turns the little word round before 'being held' puts it inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Basing a claim on evidence is establishing it, so the two verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: What Judi Dench for one does about French furniture

parts.words: What Judi Dench for one does

explanation.surface: An actress pictured doing something or other with French furniture.
explanation.walkthrough: Judi Dench is a Dame, the British honour for women matching a knighthood; 'about' puts FR inside BE DAME.
explanation.definitionFit: A bed's supporting structure is a piece of bedroom furniture.

parts.note: a second plate of food at a meal is called seconds
a divorcee is someone's ex, a former spouse

explanation.surface: A woman takes a second plate of food and gives it to someone divorced.
explanation.definitionFit: Simone de Beauvoir's famous feminist book used this phrase as a label for women as a group.

indicators.note: in a down clue, up says the little word is read from the bottom upward

parts.note: a meeting that is set is on, arranged to go ahead
OK means satisfactorily, all right

explanation.surface: A shelter has been put up to a decent standard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set up' reads as erected; 'set' gives a word meaning arranged, and 'up' turns it round in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A cosy corner or recess gives retreat and protection, a small sheltered spot.

clue.text: End this is when 30 is given naturally

definitions.text: End this is when 30 is given

explanation.surface: A seemingly obvious remark about when something finishes and an award is made.
explanation.walkthrough: 30 refers to the answer at 30 across, a university degree; the first reading takes the phrase literally, the end of the course.
explanation.definitionFit: As an interjection the phrase means certainly or obviously, just as naturally does.

parts.note: F is a musical note

indicators.note: turnover says the word for fashion is flipped end to end

explanation.walkthrough: 'turnover's' turns MODE into EDOM.
explanation.definitionFit: Having latitude to act as one chooses is a kind of flexibility, so the nouns are near-synonyms.

clue.text: What comes out of Iraq? Blair's role is complicated

indicators.note: of says the dish is made of letters taken from inside the following words

clue.text: 30 days up just like that without cars

clue.text: 30 down to reject European card company

indicators.note: first picks the opening letter of the city's name

clue.text: Backing horse a crime sometimes after first 30

clue.text: George Orwell, irascible, contrary — no saint, right?

explanation.definitionFit: George Orwell was the pen name the author of Nineteen Eighty-Four used in place of his birth name.

clue.text: Is French fury about Norway to sour relations?

heats are qualifying races before a final

parts.note: busy can mean at work, at it, so busy gives at
